purdue.name: Purdue
purdue.description: We live in married housing when my dad attends grad school.

lil-sis.name: Lil Sis
lil-sis.description: My long-awaited sister arrives, but it's not all roses.

school.name: School
school.description: I start kindergarten, another long-awaited beginning and meet my best childhood friend.

wakely.name: Wakely
wakely.description: Wakely, 22, dies after a brief and brutal battle with non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.

jeni.name: Jeni
jeni.description: Meet Jennifer, who eventually becomes a lifelong friend.

tresa.name: Tresa
tresa.description: I meet Tresa, who jokes she's my 2nd friend. She leaves home a few days after graduation and I never hear from her again.

get-a-job.name: Get a job
get-a-job.description: I had two jobs that first summer: DQ and Russells. Got fired from Russells.

julie.name: Julie
julie.description: The new girl ends up being a lifelong friend.

fall-in-love.name: Fall in love
fall-in-love.description: First love, and it's big and goes on far too long.

scholarship-dnq.name: Scholarship - DNQ
scholarship-dnq.description: I was a candidate for an academic scholarship, but did not get it, flopped the interview.

college.name: College
college.description: I attend Moorhead State University (now Minnesota State Moorhead). Learn a lot. Make lifelong friends, work several fun jobs.

fargo-moorhead.name: Fargo/Moorhead
fargo-moorhead.description: Move to Fargo-Moorhead for the college years.

academic-probation.name: Academic Probation
academic-probation.description: First taste of academic failure. I learned some hard lessons.

add-a-major.name: Add a major
add-a-major.description: Realizing I cannot do much with an English major and decide to stay an extra year to add a double major.

foc.name: FoC
foc.description: Intership becomes event planning for inaugural Festival of Champions. I do not learn to love horses.

ba.name: BA
ba.description: Bachelor of Arts in English and Mass Communications with a minor in Humanities.

real-job.name: Real Job
real-job.description: I get my first tech writing job and great mentors.

live-with-cousins.name: Live with cousins
live-with-cousins.description: I decide to share a duplex with family.

consulting.name: Consulting
consulting.description: I take a job as a consultant. Just ahead of Y2K was a great time to be a consultant. I made many great friends.

amy.name: Amy
amy.description: Met Amy doing a contract at Beckman Coulter.

broken-heart.name: Broken Heart
broken-heart.description: Finally broke it off with the high school sweetheart.

paris.name: Paris
paris.description: I take my sister to Paris as a graduation gift.

jampee.name: Jampee
jampee.description: Jampee dies by suicide three days before 9/11.

les.name: Jerk
les.description: My mentor, who is my father's age, hits on me. Crushed.

jeff.name: Jeff
jeff.description: Went on a blind date, fell in love.

australia.name: Australia
australia.description: Jeff and I go to Australia to see friends.

buy-a-house.name: Buy a house
buy-a-house.description: Jeff and I buy a home together.

manila.name: Manila
manila.description: First work trip to Manila with Chris.

elope.name: Elope
elope.description: Jeff and I elope to Tofino, B.C.

healthland.name: Healthland
healthland.description: Lawson is acquired and I go to Healthland.

female-ceo.name: Female CEO
female-ceo.description: I join Healthland to work for a woman CEO.

emergency-surgery.name: Emergency surgery
emergency-surgery.description: A broken tooth snowballs into hospitalization and emergency surgery.

infor.name: Infor
infor.description: I return to the former Lawson and embark on the most fulfilling years of work.

estrangement.name: Estrangement
estrangement.description: I am estranged from my sister for over a year.

norway.name: Norway
norway.description: My cousins and I take my uncle to meet family in Norway.

layoff.name: Layoff
layoff.description: Position eliminated. RIF-ed, a few weeks before my 50th birthday.

union.name: Union
union.description: I finally get to join a union and it is great.

mnit.name: MNIT
mnit.description: I join the state to be a solo (and only) tech writer.

chris.name: Chris
chris.description: Beloved colleague of 20+ years passes away days before my birthday. He has just turned 50.

buy-condo.name: Buy condo
buy-condo.description: Concerned for my folks, we buy a condo near us and rent it to them.

anosmia.name: Anosmia
anosmia.description: On Groundhog's Day, I fall and fracture my skull. I lost my sense of smell and taste.
